routeHint: Events in the main menu -> open any published event from the list. The left sidebar (Modify, View event, Event app, Participants, Program, Votes, Tickets, Payments, Analytics, Messages, Landing page, Report, Duplicate Event, Save as Template, Email Templates, Delete) must be visible next to the event hero. Use an UPCOMING ticketed event: a past event shows 'The event has passed' and no registration panel at all. Annual General Meeting Springfield (event 200432, 2026-09-07, product 971) is upcoming, ticketed and public. UPDATED 2026-11-11: the event header offers Share, Edit and an Actions menu holding Duplicate Event, Save as Template and Delete. Nothing reads 'View event'.
alt: Event page with the event sidebar on the left and the event hero, date, location and registration panel on the right
note: Current image predates the reworked sidebar (Agenda, Votes, Analytics, Networking spaces, Duplicate Event, Save as Template, Email Templates are all new entries). Prefer an event owned by the logged-in admin so every sidebar entry renders.

routeHint: Settings (gear) -> Modules -> Events. Capture with the inner module menu visible on the left (Configuration, Event Types, Templates, and, when enabled, Event Statuses and Attendance Reminder).
alt: Events module settings showing Event Configuration, Ticketing and Payments, Reporting and Analytics, and Additional Features sections
note: Current image is missing the Templates entry in the module menu and the newer Additional Features toggles (Restrict Event Editing by User Type, Disable Company Invoice in Checkout). Scroll so at least the Event Configuration and Ticketing and Payments sections are in frame.

routeHint: Events -> Create an event. Capture the top of the form: cover image panel on the left, then Group, Event type, Title, Location, Online meetup, and the Start/End timeline with the timezone chip. UPDATED 2026-11-11: the location choice reads In person / Online / Hybrid; there is no 'Online meetup'. Queued for recapture 2026-11-11 after the capture runner was pinned to the demo organisation's timezone: times on this screen had been drawn on the browser's clock instead.
actions: fill input[placeholder="Location"] | Norfolk, Virginia, United States
alt: Create Event form with cover image on the left and group, event type, title, location, online meetup, start and end times with timezone on the right
note: Run this file with TZ=America/New_York. The Start select renders in browser-local time while the End select renders in the event timezone (America/New_York for this tenant), so any other host timezone makes End look earlier than Start on the same day. Log in as an admin so the Access/Audience block renders.

routeHint: Events -> Create an event, then scroll to the settings card: the Access (Free/Paid) and Audience (Members only/Public) option cards, followed by the Registration section (Require registration form for members, Max capacity, Close registrations) and the Features section (Enable speakers, Visibility of attendee list, Enable 1:1 networking, Send reminder 1 hour before event starts). Queued for recapture 2026-11-11 after the capture runner was pinned to the demo organisation's timezone: times on this screen had been drawn on the browser's clock instead.
alt: Access and Audience option cards followed by the Registration and Features setting rows with toggles
note: Must be captured as an ADMIN_TENANT or FINANCIAL_TENANT user, otherwise the Access block is hidden. Leave Access on Free so Max capacity is visible.

routeHint: Settings -> Modules -> Events -> Event Types. The ACTIONS column is opacity:0 until the row is hovered (List.vue .row-actions), so the capture must hover a row or the column reads as empty on every line. 2026-11-11: route unchanged and tenant 282 has 8 event types (Chapter Meetings ... Gala Dinner). List.vue was redesigned into rows (.wf-row, drag handle, ProjectPalette color dot, .wf-name input, gear, trash) with no table and no Create Event type button, so the old hover on .event-types-table tbody tr and waitFor text=Create Event type matched nothing. Actions removed, waitFor now .wf-row.wf-add (the Add event type row, which renders only once the list has loaded; text=Gala Dinner missed because names are input values).
alt: Event types settings page listing the types in order, each with a drag handle, a color dot, an editable name, a gear icon for the event form and a trash icon, with an Add event type row at the bottom
note: Current image shows a Color column that no longer exists; the table is now Type name plus Actions only, and the module menu now sits on the left.

routeHint: Requires Enable Custom Statuses to be ON in Settings -> Modules -> Events -> Configuration; turn it on first, then Event Statuses appears in the module menu. Create two or three statuses (for example Planned, Confirmed, Finalized with Finalized marked as final) before capturing.
alt: Event statuses settings listing named statuses with their colors and a final-status marker

routeHint: Settings -> Modules -> Events -> Templates. If the tenant has no templates, create two first (one free members-only, one paid public with two ticket types) so the badges and ticket counts on the cards are visible.
alt: Event templates list showing template cards with Free or Ticket badges, audience badges, ticket counts, and cover thumbnails

routeHint: Settings -> Modules -> Events -> Templates -> open the 'Professional development day' template (id 3). The create route renders a completely empty form, so edit a seeded template instead: Template Name, Event Defaults, Description and the Access/Audience cards are all filled, and the ticket types are set.
alt: Event template editor showing Template Name, Event Defaults, Description, Access and Audience cards, and the registration form builder

routeHint: Requires at least one event template to exist. Events -> Create an event (opens a panel over the list) -> Start from template in the panel header. Capture the template picker modal with its template cards, the preview (eye) buttons, and the No template / Done footer. 2026-11-11: the Start from template button is no longer in a panel header. It is a dropdown in the event form's top bar (views/Event/Form.vue, the eform-bar-template button, shown only when the tenant has at least one template), and the picker modal is its Browse all templates entry. Actions were click Create an event, click Start from template, which now opens the dropdown (Start from + up to five templates, Browse all templates), so a click on Browse all templates was added. Tenant 282 had no templates (the only row belonged to tenant 24), so three were seeded: INSERT INTO event_template (tenant_id,name,...) for 'Annual conference' (type 1298, ticketed, Member ticket 125 and Guest ticket 185, public, 250 seats), 'Chapter meeting' (type 1293, free, 60 seats) and 'Gala dinner' (type 1300, ticketed, Dinner seat 95 and Table of eight 700, 160 seats), ids 2 to 4, no logo so the gradient thumbnail shows.
alt: Template picker modal listing the Annual conference, Chapter meeting and Gala dinner templates with Ticket or Free badges, ticket counts and a preview button, plus No template and Done actions
